messages.content_text:
I waited until 10am to open to decide on my next trade as we began trading up.
Zooming out I realized that we already manipulated below midnight KO
and it looked like we were gonna close above it.
We then inversed the hourly at 10am so I switched my DOL to PWH.
Looking for longs we had a 10am open low into a 5m FVG
Tapping the CE of a 5m OB
Lined up perfectly with .62 fib level
We rejected it to the tick then ended up making a SMT
and a 1m RB.
I entered off the start of it and came close to stop.
We chopped around for too long and ended up making EQL at my stop
Eventually broke out I moved to B/E fairly quick 
As we were approaching the high very slow I trailed my stop to 1:2 
at a 15s low
Ended up getting stopped there before it ripping to tp
